sentences.en: So Luke, for our next psychology assignment we have to do something on sleep and dreams.
sentences.zh: 所以，卢克，我们下一项心理学作业是关于睡眠和梦境的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I've just read an article suggesting why we tend to forget most of our dreams soon after we wake up.
sentences.zh: 我刚读了一篇文章，解释了为什么我们在醒来后很快就会忘记大多数梦境。

sentences.en: I mean, most of my dreams aren't that interesting anyway, but what it said was that if we remembered everything, we might get mixed up about what actually happened and what we dreamed.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我的大多数梦境本来就不那么有趣，但文章说的是，如果我们记得所有梦境，我们可能会混淆哪些是真实发生的，哪些是梦到的。

sentences.en: So it's a sort of protection.
sentences.zh: 因此，这是一种保护机制。

sentences.en: I hadn't heard that idea before.I'd always assumed that it was just that we didn't have room in our memories for all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未听说过这种观点。我一直以为只是我们的记忆容量有限，无法容纳那么多内容。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: What do you think about the idea that our dreams may predict the future?
sentences.zh: 你觉得‘梦境可能预示未来’这种说法怎么样？

sentences.en: It's a belief that you get all over the world.
sentences.zh: 这是一种遍布全球的信仰。

sentences.en: Yeah, lots of people have a story of it happening to them, but the explanation I've read is that for each dream that comes true, we have thousands that don't, but we don't notice those, we don't even remember them.
sentences.zh: 是的，很多人声称自己经历过这种情况，但我读到的解释是：每有一个成真的梦境，就有成千上万个未应验的梦境，但我们注意不到那些未应验的，甚至根本记不住它们。

sentences.en: We just remember the ones where something in the real world, like a view or an action, happens to trigger a dream memory.
sentences.zh: 我们只记得那些现实世界中的某些事物——比如某个场景或某个动作——恰好触发了梦境记忆的情况。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So it's just a coincidence really.
sentences.zh: 所以这其实只是一种巧合。

sentences.en: Something else I read about is what they call segmented sleeping.
sentences.zh: 我还读到另一件事，叫作‘分段式睡眠’。

sentences.en: That's a theory that hundreds of years ago, people used to get up in the middle of the night and have a chat or something to eat, then go back to bed.
sentences.zh: 这是一种理论，认为几百年前，人们会在半夜醒来，聊聊天或吃点东西，然后再回去睡觉。

sentences.en: So I tried it myself.
sentences.zh: 所以我亲自尝试了一下。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Well it's meant to make you more creative.
sentences.zh: 据说这样能提升创造力。

sentences.en: I don't know why.
sentences.zh: 我也不知道为什么。

sentences.en: But I gave it up after a week.
sentences.zh: 但我一周后就放弃了。

sentences.en: It just didn't fit in with my lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 它完全不符合我的生活方式。
